title: Types And Applications Of LASERS
definition: LASER stands for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation, producing a highly directional, monochromatic, and coherent beam of light.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims under Science and Technology (advanced physics, defense applications, and communication tech) and in Mains GS-3 (achievements of Indians in science & technology, indigenous tech development, and security applications).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, emission mechanisms, and properties of LASERs.
Evaluate different classifications of LASERs (Gas, Solid-state, Liquid, Semiconductor) and their specific industrial, medical, and defense applications.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims statements and structure Mains answers on cutting-edge optical technologies.
